notes.title: Update 1.1 is now live
notes.content:
Hey all, we just pushed the newest update for BD99: Update 1.1. The main focus for this update was reworking 'endless' mode to make it more challenging and engaging. In addition we also added a few new weapons, perks, and quality of life improvements. Much of this work was done by our new intern Javier. He's a great designer and developer and we look forward to working with him more in the future. You can check out some of his solo work on Itch: 

https://trivitown.itch.io/


Endless mode

 After ~20 minutes enemies will gradually get tougher
 Bosses now drop extra large EXP orbs
 Changes to enemy spawn-rates late-game
 All previous endless mode scores have been cleared and the scoreboards are empty. Endless mode is much more difficult now and you will not be able to achieve the same scores that were previously possible

Autoaim

 Although we still recommend playing mostly with autoaim off we have made some changes to make the option appear earlier and more obviously
 Advanced Targeting unlocks sooner
 Advanced Targeting is less expensive
 Added lobby 'tooltips' to call attention to newly unlocked lobby settings

Weapons and Perks

 New Weapon: Money Gun
 New Perks: Tractor Beam, Radar, Vortex Grenade
 'Dog' reworked: The perk is less expensive and the dog starts off fairly slow/weak but gets faster and stronger over time
 'ROI' is more expensive
 Flak Gun upgrade 'Passive Flak' behavior changed: it now shoots a blast of flak every second instead of continuously firing individual pieces
 Billiards Gun has bigger balls

Other changes

 Added more announcer lines
 Added/fixed tooltips when you mouse over them in the pause screen. This was in an early version of the game but was (accidentally) disabled at some point during EA
 New cosmetics
 Some changes to screenshake

Fixes

 Added more robust handling of save files. This should lessen or completely prevent the 'corrupted save file' issue reported by a few players. In the rare case of a corrupted save file there are now clear error messages and options to try to repair or delete the corrupted save
 Fixed an issue where the perk list could overlap the menu buttons in the pause screen, on ultrawide monitors
 Fixed an issue where dps would sometimes display negative numbers
 Fixed an issue where enemies would sometimes moonwalk away
 Fixed an issue with slaughterhouse scores not saving/showing correctly
 Fixed an issue where page up/down would sometimes be disabled when viewing scoreboards
 Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented achieving 'singular focus'

notes.title: 1.0 Dropping this Friday (11/15)
notes.content:
BloodDome99 will be leaving Early Access with a 1.0 update this Friday, November 15. All of the existing Early Access leaderboards will be archived with the release of 1.0, so you have 2 days to get the best scores you can and be immortalized forever. notes.title: 1.0 status update
notes.content:
Hi. As you've probably noticed September has come and gone and we didn't launch the 1.0 update. Unfortunately, between personal factors and misjudging the amount of work left to do, we didn't end up hitting our September target. We are still hard at work on the update and it's coming along pretty nicely.

In fact, we are currently doing playtests for the update. If you'd like to get advance access to 1.0, get your name in the credits, and help us launch the best update possible let us know on Discord and we can talk more about playtesting. 

We are hoping to get the update out in November, but I don't want to say anything concrete until we're confident we can deliver. That being said, we're really happy with how the update is coming along and we're optimistic you're going to love it.

Cheers!

notes.title: 0.9.4 - Performance
notes.content:
More performance improvements. This update includes pretty significant code rewrites, so please reach out if you have any issues
 If an error occurs you will see an exclamation mark (!) in the upper right corner. Hit tilde (~) to open the console and see the error message (it'd be great if you could share it with us). Opening and closing the console will clear the exclamation mark

notes.title: 0.9.2 - Performance improvements
notes.content:
We made some changes to the physics and pathing for enemies which should pretty substantially improve performance when there are large crowds of enemies
 The guitar playing enemies now have a sound effect and their projectiles look like little music notes
 Running enemies' max speed has been lowered
 Fixed an issue where 'disable all' wouldn't always disable all difficulty modifiers

notes.title: Update 0.9 is NOW LIVE
notes.content:
Thank you so much for being patient with us while we worked on our first content update! We're really excited to share this update and of course if you have any issues please reach out to us on the Steam discussions or on our Discord (which we check a bit more frequently). Anyway, here's some patch notes:

Weight Training
Use weight training to mix and match difficulty modifiers and raise your 'weight.' Winning with added weight will earn you more money, unlocks, and get you on separate VIP leaderboards.

 8 difficulty modifiers: Rough Start, Skateboard, One Handed, Stationary Shooting, Inebriated, Double Trouble, Speed Freak, Road Rage
Weapon Override
Start the round with any previously used weapon. The cost of the weapon will be deducted at the beginning of the round (you will start in debt)


Twitch Integration
The Twitch integration has been fully reworked. The new Twitch integration only requires a channel name and it should be significantly more stable. Viewers can vote on perks/weapons using the commands !a, !b, !c, !pass, !reroll


New Content

 New weapons: Burst Rifle, Flak Gun, Elephant Gun, Billiards Gun, Bow and Arrow, Fireworks Gun
 New perks: Quick Cash, Sharpshooter, Airmail, Flashbang, Snowstorm, Frozen Assets
 New songs: 6 new songs by Karl Casey of White Bat Audio and 1 new original track
 35+ new cosmetics: Unlock them by using difficulty modifiers, completing the game with different weapons, and more
Quality of Life

 The intensity of the menu glow can now be adjusted
 Leaderboards can be viewed at any time from the lobby (the second lobby room must be unlocked first)
Other fixes/changes

 Tweaks to various SFX
 Auto aim penalty only applies if auto aim is actually used (not just equipped)
 Attack drone fires faster and does more damage
 The 'Credit' perk has been completely reworked. It now only appears when you are low/negative on money and can be stacked
 New announcer lines
 Tweaks to the way projectiles bounce off enemies and walls

This update will include two highly requested features (difficulty modifiers and more starting weapons) along with new weapons, perks, music, cosmetics, and more. Check out the trailer and stay tuned:

notes.title: BloodDome99 is OUT NOW (and day 1 patch notes)
notes.content:
It's finally here! If you've been with us for a while, thank you so much for your support. If you're just joining us now, welcome! BloodDome99 is now live in Early Access

Launch

 As a small thank you for everyone who's been with us so far we are running a 20% launch discount for the next 7 days
 If you want to support us additionally, we would really appreciate you leaving a review. Steam reviews are incredibly important for small developers like us. The number of reviews on a (small) game is the main factor that determines how likely Steam is to recommend it to users who are trying to discover new games. So your review could directly mean more people play BD99, which means we can make more and better games



Day 1 patch
We are also releasing a small content patch so that everyone will have something new to try (even our beta participants and playtesters). We plan to continue releasing regular content updates throughout Early Access, so please consider joining our Discord to let us know what you'd like to see

Advanced Targeting
Unlock the Advanced Targeting kiosk from the vending machine to use auto aim, turbo fire, and other aiming options.

Other changes

 4 new weapons
 9 new hats
 2 new fractal gun upgrades (and some visual changes)
 BDC console now asks for confirmation instead of directly opening the Steam page
 Various small balance changes

New items can be added to the vending machine by unlocking achievements, completing hidden goals, hitting milestones in total kills, total deaths, wins, and more. The vending machine will not give any information on perks/weapons so it's up to you to experiment.

Other updates

 New perk: Discerning Customer
 Fractal gun reworked and buffed

notes.title: v0.5.0 - Perk/Weapon overhaul
notes.content:
Guns are no longer part of the regular perk pool. A supply drone will appear at regular intervals and deliver you a gun pickup, allowing you to choose a new gun to add to your arsenal.
 All guns have either been reworked considerably or (temporarily) removed.
 Some perks are now 'stackable.' Stackable perks can be purchased repeatedly but become more expensive each time they're purchased.
 Most perks have been reworked.
 Over 60 weapon-specific perks added.
 New Weapons: Fractal Gun, Attack Drones
 New perks: High Caliber, Spreadshot, Rubber Bullets, Splitter, Horder, Bullet Heaven, Bigger is Better, Meditation
 New enemy type.
 Goal raised from $150k to $300k.
 Exp orbs disappear faster and flash before disappearing.
 The Metal Man has more health, and a healthbar.
 Stunning an enemy now prevents them for moving for a few seconds (instead of just slowing them) and has a visual effect.
 Adjusted speed and health of some enemy types.
 Adjusted explosions to make them slightly less disruptive.
 Adjusted the speed penalty while moving and shooting.
 Adjusted enemy spawning rate.
 Adjusted leveling curve.
 Some perks have been removed (some of the removed perks may return after being reworked).
 Fixed the Metal Man's hitbox.
 The 'Default Settings' button no longer changes blood or explosion quality.
 Fixed a bug where you could die and level up at the same time.

 New perk: Medkit

 'Injury to Insult' now sets stunned enemies on fire instead of creating an explosion
 New enemy: Runner
 Leveling up pushes away nearby enemies
 Some changes to the enemy spawn curve and enemy pathing (should also improve performance late game)
 EXP orbs now disappear if not picked up after 3 minutes
 Skipping a perk now grants some money
 Added a starting lobby. It's pretty empty right now...
 Changes to the crowd and outer walls
 Can now access the options menu while in game
 Minor changes to descriptions, costs, balance, and visual effects for various perks
 Various audio changes and tweaks
 Various UI changes
 Various small VFX changes
 Pushback behaves differently on the backend, but it should be relatively unnoticeable while playing
 Fixed a bug where holding fire too quickly after coming out of a menu would prevent you from shooting until the button was released and re-pressed


Also, I will be clearing all old high scores of less than 10 minutes. With changes to the boss and spawn curves I believe it will be much harder to get a sub-10 minute time. Feel free to prove me wrong ;)
